## The rule
One sentence, phrased as a behavior.

## Level
- [ ] L1 and L2
- [ ] L2 only

## Side
- [ ] Human checklist
- [ ] Agent rules
- [ ] Template

## The failure
What actually went wrong? A real case from your agent work.

## The catch
How would this rule have caught it, and at which step?

## The cost
What does following this rule cost every time?

## If the agent rules are at the 12-rule cap
Which existing rule should be merged or removed?
